name: @aikami/local-stack
description: Compose profiles, backend overrides, checksum-verified model fetcher, and Native Host Binary launchers for the local AI engine stack (C-390).

scripts.lint: bash -n bin/*.sh aikami install.sh scripts/*.sh docker/voice/entrypoint.sh && bash scripts/check.sh --static && bunx biome check stack/*.ts
scripts.fix: bunx biome check --write stack/*.ts && bash -n bin/run-native-llm.sh bin/run-native-tts.sh bin/run-native-stt.sh docker/voice/entrypoint.sh scripts/emit_config.sh scripts/check.sh
scripts.build: bun run build:client && docker compose build
scripts.build:client: cd ../../frontend/client && bun run build:production && cd ../../backend/local-stack && bun run stage:client
scripts.build:client:staging: cd ../../frontend/client && bun run build:staging && cd ../../backend/local-stack && bun run stage:client
scripts.build:client:emulator: cd ../../frontend/client && bun run build:emulator && cd ../../backend/local-stack && bun run stage:client
scripts.build:client:docker: bun run build:client && docker build -f Dockerfile.client -t aikami-client .
